title: Reverse Nodes in K-Group
description: Given the head of a linked list, reverse the nodes of the list `k` at a time, and return the modified list. If the number of nodes is not a multiple of `k` then left-out nodes at the end should remain as-is.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `k`. Second line contains `n` integers.

sample_tests.explanation: Reversed first group of 3, 4 and 5 remain.

hints: Check if there are at least k nodes remaining before reversing each group.
Reverse k nodes using the standard iterative reversal pointer manipulation.
Connect the previous group's tail to the new group's head.
